iconography.iconographic_notes: Identified in Evans (1909), Duhoux (1977), and Godart (1995) as Rosette.

phonetics.epistemic_warning: Phonetic value ['/ru/', '/ro/'] is an unverified projection from Linear A/B. Cannot be considered established decipherment.

expert_synthesis: Phaistos Disc Sign 24 (Rosette) depicts 8-petaled sacred solar/floral palace rosette. Iconographically, it correlates with Cretan Hieroglyphic CH_070 and Linear A AB08. Proposed phonetic assignments ['/ru/', '/ro/'] remain tentative under the Shannon unicity limit.
skeptic_ruling: SKEPTIC RULING (Sign 24): Physical stamping die observed. Realia classification (Rosette) is well-supported by Middle Minoan iconography. Phonetic projection ['/ru/', '/ro/'] carries high degrees of freedom and must be treated as a working hypothesis.
